cases.question: What was total company net revenue in 2025, retail and wholesale combined?
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_channel_sales
WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND sale_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: Compare net revenue for retail and wholesale in 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    business,
    ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_channel_sales
WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND sale_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY business
ORDER BY business

cases.question: Gross margin percentage for retail versus wholesale last quarter
cases.sql:
SELECT
  business,
  ROUND(SUM(gross_margin) / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM analytics.fct_channel_sales
WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND sale_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
  AND business IN ('retail', 'wholesale')
GROUP BY business
ORDER BY business

cases.question: Show monthly company net revenue in 2026, oldest month first
cases.sql:
SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', sale_date) AS DATE) AS month,
    ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_channel_sales
WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND sale_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

cases.question: Top 3 brands by total gross margin dollars in 2026 across retail and wholesale
cases.sql:
SELECT
    p.brand,
    ROUND(SUM(s.gross_margin), 2) AS gross_margin
FROM analytics.fct_channel_sales AS s
JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p
    ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.sale_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND s.sale_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 3

cases.question: Retail net revenue by channel in 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    channel,
    ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

cases.question: What was retail net revenue by region last quarter?
cases.sql:
SELECT
    st.region,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_sales AS fs
INNER JOIN analytics.dim_store AS st
    ON fs.store_id = st.store_id
WHERE fs.order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND fs.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY st.region
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

cases.question: How many retail orders were placed in September 2026?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS retail_orders
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-09-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'

cases.question: Average order value by channel in 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    channel,
    ROUND(SUM(net_revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0), 2) AS average_order_value
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY channel

cases.question: Compare return rate by product category across all time
cases.sql:
SELECT
    p.category,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.is_returned THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM analytics.fct_sales AS s
JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p
    ON s.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category

cases.question: What was the retail discount rate in November and December 2025 combined?
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(discount_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_revenue), 0) * 100,
    2
) AS discount_rate_pct
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-11-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: Top 5 stores by net revenue in 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    ROUND(SUM(f.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_sales AS f
JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s
    ON f.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE f.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND f.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

cases.question: Which 3 men's shoe sizes sold the most pairs at retail in 2026, excluding returns?
cases.sql:
SELECT
    s.size,
    SUM(s.quantity) FILTER (WHERE NOT s.is_returned) AS pairs_sold
FROM analytics.fct_sales AS s
JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p
    ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE s.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND s.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
  AND p.gender = 'Men'
GROUP BY s.size
ORDER BY pairs_sold DESC, s.size
LIMIT 3

cases.question: Which 5 wholesale accounts had the highest net revenue in 2026?
cases.sql:
SELECT
    a.account_name,
    ROUND(SUM(w.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_wholesale AS w
JOIN analytics.dim_account AS a
    ON w.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE w.ship_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND w.ship_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY a.account_id, a.account_name
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

cases.question: Wholesale net revenue and gross margin percentage by account type in 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    a.account_type,
    ROUND(SUM(w.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(w.gross_margin) / NULLIF(SUM(w.net_revenue), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM analytics.fct_wholesale AS w
JOIN analytics.dim_account AS a
    ON w.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE w.ship_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND w.ship_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY a.account_type
ORDER BY a.account_type

cases.question: What was the wholesale fill rate by ship month in 2026, oldest first?
cases.sql:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', ship_date)::DATE AS ship_month,
    ROUND(SUM(units_shipped) / NULLIF(SUM(units_ordered), 0) * 100, 2) AS fill_rate_pct
FROM analytics.fct_wholesale
WHERE ship_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND ship_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY ship_month
ORDER BY ship_month

cases.question: On-time shipping rate by account type for wholesale lines shipped in Q3 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    a.account_type,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN w.ship_date <= w.requested_ship_date THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 2) AS on_time_rate_pct
FROM analytics.fct_wholesale AS w
JOIN analytics.dim_account AS a
    ON w.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE w.ship_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND w.ship_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY a.account_type
ORDER BY a.account_type

cases.question: How many pairs did we short wholesale accounts in 2026, meaning ordered but not shipped?
cases.sql:
SELECT SUM(GREATEST(units_ordered - units_shipped, 0)) AS pairs_short
FROM analytics.fct_wholesale
WHERE ship_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND ship_date < DATE '2027-01-01'

cases.question: How many wholesale accounts are there of each type?
cases.sql:
SELECT account_type, COUNT(*) AS wholesale_accounts
FROM analytics.dim_account
GROUP BY account_type
ORDER BY account_type

cases.question: How many pairs are on hand right now?
cases.sql:
SELECT SUM(on_hand_units) AS pairs_on_hand
FROM analytics.fct_inventory
WHERE snapshot_month = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_month)
    FROM analytics.fct_inventory
)

cases.question: How many store, product and size combinations are below their reorder point in the latest snapshot?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS combinations_below_reorder_point
FROM analytics.fct_inventory
WHERE snapshot_month = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_month) FROM analytics.fct_inventory)
  AND on_hand_units < reorder_point

cases.question: Weeks of supply by product category right now
cases.sql:
SELECT
    p.category,
    ROUND(SUM(i.on_hand_units) / NULLIF(SUM(i.weekly_units_sold), 0), 2) AS weeks_of_supply
FROM analytics.fct_inventory AS i
JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE i.snapshot_month = DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category

cases.question: Sell-through by brand in August 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT p.brand,
       ROUND(SUM(i.units_sold) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(i.units_sold) + SUM(i.on_hand_units), 0), 2) AS sell_through_pct
FROM analytics.fct_inventory i
JOIN analytics.dim_product p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE i.snapshot_month = DATE '2026-08-01'
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY p.brand

cases.question: What is the value at cost of current inventory by region?
cases.sql:
SELECT
    s.region,
    ROUND(SUM(i.on_hand_units * p.unit_cost), 2) AS inventory_value_at_cost
FROM analytics.fct_inventory AS i
JOIN analytics.dim_store AS s
    ON i.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN analytics.dim_product AS p
    ON i.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE i.snapshot_month = DATE '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region

cases.question: How many customers are in each segment?
cases.sql:
SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM analytics.dim_customer
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment

cases.question: Revenue per customer by loyalty tier in 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
    c.loyalty_tier,
    ROUND(SUM(s.net_revenue) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id), 0), 2) AS revenue_per_customer
FROM analytics.fct_sales AS s
JOIN analytics.dim_customer AS c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE s.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND s.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY c.loyalty_tier
ORDER BY c.loyalty_tier

cases.question: How many active customers bought something in Q3 2026?
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS active_customers
FROM analytics.fct_sales
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'

cases.question: What was the repeat customer rate in Q3 2026?
cases.sql:
WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
    FROM analytics.fct_sales
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
      AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT ROUND(
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count >= 2) * 100.0
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
) AS repeat_customer_rate_pct
FROM customer_orders

cases.question: Return on ad spend by marketing channel in 2026
cases.sql:
SELECT
  marketing_channel,
  ROUND(SUM(attributed_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(spend), 0), 2) AS roas
FROM analytics.fct_marketing
WHERE week_start >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND week_start < DATE '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY marketing_channel
ORDER BY marketing_channel

cases.question: Total marketing spend in Q4 2025
cases.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS marketing_spend
FROM analytics.fct_marketing
WHERE week_start >= DATE '2025-10-01'
  AND week_start < DATE '2026-01-01'
